pjam.com/changelog/overview.md): Track the latest updates, features, and improvements to MCPJam Inspector\n- [Home](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/inspector/home.md): Org-scoped dashboard with activity stats, recommended servers, and quick-start clients\n- [Clients](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/clients.md): Reusable MCP client configurations for testing servers and apps under realistic con
ditions\n- [Multi-server connections](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/connecting-servers.md): Connect to multiple MCP servers wi
th different transport methods\n- [Projects](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/projects.md): Group your MCP servers into projects,
with the ability to share them with your team\n- [MCP protocol versions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/protocol-versions.md):
Pin the inspector to a specific MCP protocol version, including the 2026-07-28 stateless RC, to test how your server behaves acro
ss versions.\n- [Host Compatibility](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/host-compat.md): See which hosts your MCP server will work
in (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot) the moment you connect\n- [Skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/skills.md): Load and us
e skills to give your agents the context they need to use MCP tools effectively\n- [Playground](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/
playground.md): Chat with your MCP servers, invoke tools by hand, render widgets, and inspect every step, all in one IDE-style wor
kspace\n- [Evaluate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md): Author test cases for your MCP server, run them across models, a
nd gate pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-as-judge.\n- [View origins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/view
-origins.md): Which origin your MCP App's view runs at, and how to allowlist it with a third-party API\n- [Host presets](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/inspector/host-templates.md): What MCPJam's built-in host presets capture, and which fields to get right when you m
irror a host in your own Client.\n- [OAuth Debugger](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/guided-oauth.md): Debug your MCP server's O
Auth implementation at every step of the handshake\n- [XAA Debugger](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/xaa-debugger.md): Configure
and debug Cross-App Access flows with MCPJam as the test identity provider and client/agent\n- [Mid-session sign-in](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/inspector/lazy-authentication.md): Test servers that let you connect without signing in and ask for sign-in only when
a protected call needs it\n- [MCP Inspector](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/tools-prompts-resources.md): Manually test your MCP
server's tools, resources, and prompts\n- [Tracing & debugging](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/debugging.md): See all messages
sent to and from your MCP server\n- [Telemetry & privacy](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/telemetry-privacy.md): What the Inspe
ctor sends to analytics and error reporting, how links that act as credentials are kept out of it, and how to opt out\n- [Launch f
rom Code (Beta)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/launch-from-code.md): Programmatically launch and configure MCPJam Inspector fr
om your code or build tools\n- [MCP Docs Server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/docs-server.md): Connect AI applications to MCP
Jam documentation\n- [My First MCP App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/guides/first-mcp-app.md): Build a simple Reservation MCP App from
scratch\n- [My First ChatGPT App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/guides/first-chatgpt-app-react.md): Build a simple Coffee Shop ChatGPT A
pp with React\n- [CLI Overview](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md): Local MCP testing and mcpjam cloud: probing, debugging,
OAuth, conformance, and hosted evals from your terminal\n- [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/migration.md): Comma
nd-path and flag changes when account-bound mcpjam commands moved under mcpjam cloud\n- [Local Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/
local-evals.md): Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with local results and an MCPJam identity\n- [MCPJ
am as an MCP Server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/mcp-server.md): Run MCPJam as a local stdio MCP server so agents can connect to,
exercise, and debug other MCP servers\n- [Server Inspection](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/server-inspection.md): Probe, diagnose, a
nd export MCP server connectivity and capabilities\n- [OAuth Conformance](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-conformance.md): Test
your MCP server's OAuth implementation across all registration methods and protocol versions\n- [OAuth Login & Debugging](https://

# Server Inspection

> Probe, diagnose, and export MCP server co
nnectivity and capabilities\n\nThe `server` command group gives you a breadth-first view of any MCP server (connectivity, OAuth di

scovery, capabilities, tools, resources, and prompts) without writing code.

## Quick start

```bash theme={"theme":"css-va
riables\"}\n# One command does everything: probe, connect, sweep tools/resources/prompts\nmcpjam server doctor --url https://your-

server.com/mcp
```
